title: Varun Choraria
subtitle: Varun Choraria's personal site. Essays on GTM, product marketing, management and AI, plus open-source AI tools.

posts.title: The Detroit mistake
posts.description: GM's market fell nearly 10% in 10 years after the automation push. I made the same mistake with AI spend, then started measuring cost per task.

posts.title: Butler AI: Alfred’s real job was knowing what to ignore
posts.description: I run a small team of AI agents on a shared Notion brain and Cloudflare's Clef. The hard part isn't what they can do, it's what they ignore, when they stay quiet, and how my feedback turns into their rules.

posts.title: Paper cuts from dull scissors
posts.description: 3 months between jobs. I told myself it was rest. It was mostly a collapse I called a break. What outlasted it.
